messages:
Nina: Noticing odd quota spikes tied to routing-fanout canary. SDKs hitting 409s and console shows doubled token counts.
Omar: example?
Nina: requests with `X-Rdw-Route` but missing `X-Rdw-Quota` are being expanded server-side -> multiple quota attributions.
Jules: quick fixcould be SDKs adding a fallback quota header when absent. Router change is riskier.
DeployBot: deploy 2026-03-23T11:02:00 2% fanout-canary.
Priya: agree SDK-first. plan: py + go patch to set `X-Rdw-Quota: sdk-fallback` unless env SKIP_QUOTA_FALLBACK present. add telemetry flag `quota_fallback=true` so console can track.
Omar: timeline?
Nina: devex can cut patch in 90m, canary rollout 5% then quick expand. Router guard as fallback if errors persist.
Jules: I'll add a short-lived console tile showing fallback fraction and a monitor if >1% and 5xx elevated.
Priya: also capture client-id in router logs for reconciliation. long-term: requirement doc to standardize header negotiation.
Nina: filing follow-up doc and owner assigned (Jules). closing loop after canary results.
